To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We developed a replicable, distributed, Internet-based negotiation architecture for conducting bargaining-type negotiation between enterprises engaged in e-commerce and business.

1) A negotiation server can be used to represent a company's negotiation interests and policies, and 2) A constraint satisfaction processor can be used to evaluate a proposal against the registered requirements/constraints of a client company, and trigger the execution of strategic rules to resolve constraint violations.

the design and implementation is replicable, that a negotiation server can be used to represent the interests of a buyer/seller in an e-commerce environment, that a negotiation protocol can be used to conduct bargaining type negotiations between buyers and sellers, that negotiation strategic rules can be used to automate the negotiation process, that a constraint satisfaction processor can be used to evaluate a proposed agreement against registered constraints, that a cost-benefit analysis can be used to quantify the cost and benefit of a proposed agreement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of negotiation servers that support automated negotiations in the context of e-business and e-commerce.
the design of a flexible, scalable, and robust architecture for conducting automated negotiations in e-business applications.
the development of negotiation server software that can be installed at a client company to conduct negotiations on its behalf.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this work has been able to demonstrate the viability and usefulness of the negotiation server as a component of the e-business infrastructure, and the ability of the negotiation server to provide a comprehensive and flexible solution for conducting automated negotiation in the context of a supply chain.
the negotiation server is a viable and practical solution for conducting e-business negotiations.
the proposed system is an effective, reliable, and efficient negotiation server, and that it has the potential for use in a variety of e-commerce applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our approach to negotiation server design and implementation is based on a client/server architecture with the negotiation servers acting as the servers, and the client enterprises acting as the clients.
our approach to automated negotiation is based on the use of negotiation servers, which are installed at each participating enterprise.
we are developing a negotiation server that can be installed by a buyer or a supplier to conduct automated negotiations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
negotiation servers are a viable solution to the problem of automated negotiation.

the use of negotiation servers can significantly reduce the time and effort required by enterprises to conduct negotiations, thus making it possible to conduct more negotiations and achieve better results.
negotiation servers can be used to automate negotiations and to provide a framework for the development of negotiation strategies.
